text:
maya: Quick check — we have one week until the target ship. I sketched acceptance questions for SLA/docs/support/monitoring/pricing. Who can own gaps?

sam: I can take SLA specifics. Need a clear SLO doc and a fallback policy.

jordan: Support readiness: runbook + triage flow needed. Who will own oncall rotations for dedicated customers?

li: Ops: I can map monitoring dashboards to runbook steps. Need signal list (errors, latency percentiles, cache hit rate).

devon: Pricing: we need final per-token vs tiered plan numbers + examples for customers. Also bundle math for Dedicated commits.

maya: Great. SLA items: sam, can you answer these by EOD? 1) latency p95 target for hosted vs dedicated; 2) measured cost impact for 50k qps; 3) fallback policy (model downgrade/regional failover).

sam: Quick notes: p95 hosted target = 180ms for 2k tokens typical; dedicated target = 80ms. Cost impact depends on batching — I'll attach numbers. Fallback we propose: fallback to quantized variant -> region failover -> queueing with 503-backoff.

jordan: For support, we need: oncall rotation doc, incident severity matrix, and escalation for billing disputes. I can draft the matrix. @li — can you confirm alert noise won't blow up SRE on day 1?

li: I'll run the alert pruning job today. Top alerts to keep: model OOM, serving latency > 2x SLO for 5m, KV cache corruption, auth failures. Everything else should be paged only if it correlates with traffic drop or error spike.

maya: Docs: we need a customer-facing "what to expect" page (latency, regional limits, SLA table), and an internal ops runbook. Who can own the customer page?

devon: I can take customer pricing examples (2-3 personas). Will need SAM numbers from sam and expected token distribution from product.

sam: Will share numbers. Also adding a short note for sales: guaranteed throughput and reserved capacity tiers.

jordan: Draft runbook checklist: impact assessment, rollback steps, customer comms template, billing credit calc. I'll open a PR for templates.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary rollout to 10% at 2026-04-02T02:00Z. If errors > 1% abort.

maya: Good callout. We need an abort playbook tied to the deploy-bot thresholds. sam/jordan/li — can you sync and produce a 1-page abort playbook?

sam: I'll draft it. Include quick commands:
```
# show tail logs
prod-logs tail --service=inference --last=100
# check latency
metrics query --series=latency.p95 --range=15m
```

jordan: I'll add comm templates and who to call (CSE, account manager).

li: I'll add the exact alert conditions and a runbook step: "if p95 > 2x for 10m -> rollback to previous model variant".

maya: Outstanding gaps list (quick):
- final SLO doc (sam)
- customer-facing latency/pricing page (devon + sam)
- support runbook + severity matrix (jordan)
- alert tuning and dashboard links (li)
- abort playbook + deploy thresholds (sam/jordan/li)
- billing credit calc and contract language (devon + legal)

maya: Can each owner add a sign-off message in this thread when done? I'll collect and confirm with execs.

sam: sign-off plan: aim to post SLA doc by 2026-03-25 18:00 UTC.

jordan: Support templates PR by EOD 2026-03-25.

li: Dashboards updated and alerts pruned by 2026-03-25 20:00 UTC.

devon: Pricing examples and billing credit calc by 2026-03-25 23:59 UTC.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation swap scheduled for 2026-03-26.

maya: Thanks all. I'll compile sign-offs and send to GTM + legal after the deadlines. Ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:
